'''Jyrzk''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who considered hooking up the drive system and [[Navigation computer/Legends|astrogation computer]] of a [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid's]] hyperspace jump pod to an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], and use it to dump small cargoes to a specific location whenever there was a danger of being boarded by customs patrol.
